name: Mountain Xpress

access.robots: User-agent * disallows /wp-admin/ and the Events Calendar's expensive views (/events/month/, /events/*/day/, /events/photo/, ?tribe-bar-date=, ?eventDisplay=, ?eventDate=). About 45 AI/SEO agents (ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, anthropic-ai, GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, CCBot, PerplexityBot, Applebot-Extended, Meta-ExternalAgent, cohere-ai...) are Disallow: /. Sitemaps: sitemap.xml, sitemap-news.xml. robots.txt itself sits behind the Cloudflare challenge for plain Node.

qualityWhy: Asheville's independent weekly: city/county government, elections (the On the Record candidate interviews), environment, education, business, plus letters and arts/food features. Original reporting, almost all of it Asheville/Buncombe.
recommendationWhy: Core Asheville source. WP REST gives the full body, featured image and clean categories. RSS gives bylines and doubles as a fallback when the REST path is challenged.
testResult: OK mountainx - 16 articles, published 2026-09-15..2026-09-24; summary 100% | contentText 100% | image 100% | author 81% | categories 100%; avg body 5,356 chars; feed-fallback run: fetchFullText ok 3/3
notes: Raw volume is ~2.9 posts/day. Dropped: 'Smart Bets' (one-event previews, i.e. listings, 16 of the last 100 posts; matched by tag or title prefix) and the Humor category (editorial cartoons with empty bodies, and satire that would read as fact). Kept: News and all its subsections (Local Government, Politics & Elections, Environment, Education, Business, Nonprofits, Community News, History...), Opinion (Letters, Commentary), Arts, Food News, Living. No place filter: 14 of 16 test items name a Buncombe place, and the other two are regional arts features. The calendar is the tribe_events post type, so it never appears in /posts. Cloudflare: /feed/ is served to plain Node (fetchFeed), but /wp-json/ is challenged and needs fetchAsChrome; in my runs it got through within the 4-attempt retry every time (0-2 challenges). CLAUDE.md says Cloudflare challenges every Vercel request for the events API, so on Vercel expect the REST path to fail and the module to fall back to feed-only (excerpt + byline + categories, no image). fetchFullText (a REST lookup by slug) is then likely challenged too, because article pages sit behind the same Cloudflare rule, which is why it uses fetchAsChrome rather than fetchNewsText. I left localOnly off because /feed/ may still work from Vercel; untested. The REST API hides users (the author embed returns rest_user_invalid_id; /users/<id> is a 404), so bylines come from RSS dc:creator joined on post id (guid ?p=<id>). The REST window is set to 25 posts to match the ~20-item feed. Letters carry the byline 'Letters'. Xpress republishes Asheville Watchdog stories ('Asheville Watchdog' byline) and CPP stories ('From CPP:' titles), so cross-source dedup will see exact duplicates. Side finding for the events scraper: robots.txt now disallows /events/month/ for all agents, which is the lib/scrapers/mountainx.ts month-view HTML fallback tier (the owner has said robots.txt is not a blocker).

name: Asheville Watchdog

access.robots: User-agent * Disallow: (nothing). ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, GoogleOther, GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, Meta-ExternalAgent, Bytespider, Baiduspider: Disallow: /.

license: Free republication with credit, unedited, taglines kept (the Watchdog's own policy, not Creative Commons)
qualityWhy: Nonprofit investigative newsroom of veteran (several Pulitzer-winning) reporters: Mission/HCA, city and county government, Helene recovery, development, plus John Boyle's twice-weekly Answer Man and opinion columns.
recommendationWhy: The deepest Asheville/Buncombe accountability reporting, with the full body free via WP REST.
testResult: OK avlwatchdog - 20 articles, published 2026-09-08..2026-09-24; summary 100% | contentText 100% | image 100% | author 100% | categories 100%; avg body 8,706 chars
notes: Newspack on Automattic's CDN (server-timing: a8c-cdn), which 403s stale Chrome user agents: Chrome/120 (lib/scrapers/base.ts) and Chrome/122 (fetchAsChrome) are refused whatever the TLS fingerprint. The shared NEWS_USER_AGENT (Chrome/140) that fetchWpPosts now sends passes, hence fetchAsChrome 'blocked' above. Bylines are Co-Authors Plus: _embedded.author is a 401, so names come from parsely.meta.author, falling back to yoast_head_json.author, via lib/news/sources/shared/newspack.ts (nested _fields keeps 20 posts near 1 MB). The two closing boilerplate paragraphs (social-comments invitation and nonprofit tagline) are stripped from contentText. No place filter: 17 of 20 name a Buncombe place in the headline or dek, and the rest are opinion on the district's congressman and statewide races. Rights: robots.txt names AI agents, and the republishing policy (https://avlwatchdog.org/want-to-republish-our-content-heres-what-to-know/) covers republishing in full with credit. The owner's stance is that the body is stored internally for dedup/summaries while the UI shows only our summary and links out, and that he will remove any outlet that asks. The same stories also appear on Mountain Xpress and The Beacon Tribune.

name: 828newsNOW

access.robots: Crawl-Delay: 20. User-agent * disallows /newsletter/, /nc/, /specspots/, /refer/, /wp-admin/, /wp-content/plugins/, /readme.html. CCBot, Amazonbot, SemrushBot, MJ12bot, PetalBot, KimiBot and a few others: Disallow: /. No Claude/GPT rules. /wp-json/ allowed.

qualityWhy: Saga Communications' Asheville radio newsroom (WWNC/WISE/WOXL/WTMT). High-volume, genuinely local daily news: APD/BCSO/courts, city council, housing, Helene recovery, business openings, UNCA and high-school sports. Short pieces, many built on press releases, plus some original features.
recommendationWhy: The highest-volume Buncombe source in this category, with full text free via a custom-post-type REST endpoint, and paid content that can be filtered reliably.
testResult: OK 828newsnow - 35 articles, published 2026-09-18..2026-09-24; summary 100% | contentText 100% | image 97% | author 83% | categories 91%; avg body 2,595 chars; ~23s (includes the 20s crawl delay)
notes: Mine by the lead's assignment (scout-mainstream dropped it). Stories are the custom type /wp-json/wp/v2/news, not /posts; the /feed/ RSS holds only contest posts. Embedding wp:term costs ~140 KB a post (AIOSEO data on every term): 42 posts came to 7 MB and 20s. So the module reads the 44 section names once (/wp-json/wp/v2/sections) and embeds only author and media (~1 MB). Paid content: 'Native Advertising' is also stamped on the newsroom's crime briefs, which show 'Sponsored by <company>' but are staff-written from police/court releases and carry saga_news_source_category=Saga Comm. The actual ads (Massage Envy promo, the weekend 'Things to do' listing, fundraiser plugs, history filler) have no saga_news_source_category, so those are dropped, along with advertiser columns ('... Expert', 'Ask The Expert', 'Shop Simply'). 26 of 100 recent posts were labelled Native Advertising; ~10 were real ads. Kept crime briefs keep 'Native Advertising' in categories verbatim. Geography: shared/buncombe.ts mentionsBuncombe over title/dek/URL/body drops the Hendersonville, Marshall and Pisgah-forest stories (3 of 38 in the test); a few McDowell crime briefs survive via 'Mission Hospital McDowell'. The house byline '828newsNOW' becomes undefined. The 20-second crawl delay from robots.txt is honoured between the two requests.

name: Carolina Public Press

access.robots: User-agent * Disallow: (nothing); no AI-agent rules. Sitemaps incl. news-sitemap.xml.

testResult: OK carolinapublicpress - 8 articles (Buncombe filter kept 8 of 20), published 2026-08-24..2026-09-23; summary 100% | contentText 100% | image 100% | author 100% | categories 100%; avg body 12,376 chars

The other 6 kept match in the body: the Mission/Buncombe hospital-bed and certificate-of-need series, Flock backlash in WNC, Helene volunteer groups, and a Cherokee County power-line story that mentions Asheville in passing (enrichment should judge those). estLocalShare is the kept share. In-body newsletter plugs ('[ Subscribe for FREE ... ]') are stripped. The 'En español' category holds Spanish translations of English stories (duplicates for dedup). Mountain Xpress and The Beacon Tribune republish CPP stories.

name: The Urban News

access.robots: User-agent * disallows /wp-admin/, /cgi-bin/, /xmlrpc.php, plugins, login/register/password pages. No AI-agent rules. /wp-json/ allowed.

qualityWhy: Asheville's Black-owned community paper: Black Asheville, civil rights, elections, community health, local columns (Nelda Holder, Johnnie Grant). Also carries many press releases and event announcements.
recommendationWhy: A community voice no other source covers, and trivially cheap (stock fetchWpPosts, full text).
testResult: OK urbannews - 44 articles ('National News' wire dropped, 6 of 50), published 2026-09-07..2026-09-24; summary 100% | contentText 100% | image 100% | author 7% | categories 100%; avg body 3,128 chars

name: The Beacon Tribune

access.robots: Not fetched (the TownNews throttle was active). BLOX sites generally allow /search/ and article pages.

qualityWhy: Buncombe community weekly (successor to the Weaverville/North Buncombe Tribune papers, whose tribpapers.com now redirects here). Its own reporting covers Weaverville, Woodfin, Leicester and North Buncombe (e.g. the Weaverville fire chief's resignation), plus sheriff/court briefs. About half of each issue is reprints of Asheville Watchdog, CPP, BPR and NC Newsline stories.
recommendationWhy: The lead's gap-check pick. Buncombe-only, free (no active BLOX access rules), full text readable on the article page, and its North Buncombe coverage appears nowhere else. Reprints are cheap for dedup to collapse, and bylines name the partner outlet.
testResult: OK beacontribune - 50 articles (RSS path), published 2026-08-28..2026-09-23; summary 100% | contentText 0% | image 96% | author 38% | categories 0%; fetchFullText ok 3/3 (858 / 1,682 / 1,583 chars). Section-front fallback (feed forced to 429): 21 articles, same sourceIds, 20 with images.
notes: TownNews BLOX. ~12 news items a week, all dated the Wednesday the issue appears (04:00Z = midnight ET, date-only). scrape() reads the news-section search RSS (50 items, ~4 weeks) for title, dek, byline and image. BLOX runs the partner outlet into the byline ('By Ted Clifford Asheville Watchdog'), which the module turns into 'Ted Clifford, Asheville Watchdog'. TownNews throttles every ?f=rss request per client IP (/search/ and section ?f=rss alike): after a handful it answers 429, sometimes for an hour or more, while HTML pages keep answering. fetchEventData's 3 quick retries sometimes get through. If not, the module falls back to the HTML section front /news/ (the latest ~21 cards: title, dek, time, image; no byline). Both paths use the asset uuid as sourceId, so switching paths never duplicates. fetchFullText reads #article-body, drops ad containers and empty tncms regions, cuts at a bare '###' (reprints put the partner tagline after it), and returns nothing if the page's isAccessibleForFree meta is 'false'. Today it is 'true', subscription.required=false and tncms-access-version is empty, so no paywall is involved. Image URLs have the crop/resize query stripped to get the original. It's labelled 'The Beacon Tribune' in og:site_name, but the domain is still biltmorebeacon.com.
